method: Supabase MCP connector, execute_sql, SELECT-only. This is not check_db.py's direct Postgres-protocol connection (the box blocks that protocol; see 02-box-connect-attempt.txt).
stock_query: select a.sku, coalesce((select sum(quantity) from assetentry e where e.asset_id=a.id),0) - coalesce((select sum(quantity) from assetexit x where x.asset_id=a.id),0) from asset a order by a.sku

pooler_host_port_check.reason: The MCP SQL API is not a client session to the Transaction pooler. check_db.py also requires host ending in pooler.supabase.com and port 6543. The box still times out on that protocol.

result_reason: Stock and row counts match EXPECTED exactly (same as 01-readback.json from 2026-11-06). The pooler TCP path of check_db.py was not executed from the box.
